note: credentials signed by ca2a_runtime; headers are regtest difficulty, ten minutes apart

vectors.description: B pays X 7,000 per call three times under A's budget of 30,000: every payment counted, every execution paid
five calls at 7,000 under 30,000: the fifth payment (35,000) is budget_exceeded; per-call caps and use counts would both have passed it
the task commits to 7,000, the payment says 5,000
a result receipt for a priced request with no payment logged before it
a counted payment with no result receipt by the checkpoint: unexecuted
a retry of the same payment is duplicate_payment, the total is 7,000
B delegates to B2; B2's payment under the longer chain counts against A's budget on hop 1: 14,000 over 10,000
a budget of 5,000 signed by the leaf's own subject is not a limit
the operator never logs A's budget of 10,000; two witnesses did before the payments' seen block, so the second payment is budget_exceeded
the payments name block 95, older than the witnessing: budget_order_unresolved, not exceeded and not clean
30,000 then 10,000 logged between the calls: the second payment runs at 14,000 against 10,000
the responder denies; the payment stays counted and unexecuted
the payment names a block the view does not hold
the payment goes to Y while the request and the execution name X: the payment does not match, and X executed unpaid
without the task the price is the payer's word; the budget still counts it
a budget of 10 USD does not cap JPY payments; amounts in different units are not compared

the second payment names a lineage that is nobody's; the request it names commits to the real one, so the payment does not match the request, is not counted, and the execution it was meant to cover is unpaid
the use is logged after the payment: counted, lineage verified by that use
an outsider logs a 29,000 payment for B's request first: it is not the request's caller, so it is not counted and B's own payment is the one the execution is paid by
1 then 7,000 for the same request: both count against the budget (7,001), the execution is paid by the one that is the task's price
the payer prices and pays in 'jpy' under a budget in 'JPY': not compared, and every payment says so

B holds a second credential straight from the root and logs a use under it for the same request: the request commits to the budgeted lineage, so a payment under the other one does not match and the execution is unpaid
without the request occurrence the payment cannot be matched: reported with its amount, not counted; the execution is priced by the budget and has no payment to show
a task priced at zero needs no payment even though the lineage has a budget
no task, no payment, and the only budget is witnessed with an unresolved order: the requirement to pay is itself unresolved, not clean
the operator dates the payment hours before the block it says it had seen: flagged like a receipt
two payments of 2^53-1: the running total is clamped and marked, the settlement stays JSON
a supplied request whose task_sha256 is a list is skipped, not raised
